services.desc: Because where else are you going to find the best food at any brewery in the state paired with beer from a top-rated brewery in Florida? Whether it’s your birthday, your boss’s retirement, or just an excuse to day-drink on a Tuesday - we’ve got you covered. Bring your friends, your enemies, your third-grade teacher - we don’t care, as long as everyone’s ready for a good time. Great beer, great food, and questionable dance moves highly encouraged. Host your next gathering in our private event room, perfect for groups of up to 45 people.
